Functional Modules

Engineered With Complete Operational Modules

Everything required to coordinate frontline operators, parts inventory, accounting, and customer communication in Workshop OS.

Customer & Vehicle Profiling

Comprehensive records of vehicle registration number, chassis number, make, model, service history, and owner contact details.

Digital Job Card & Bay Tracking

Generate instant job cards upon vehicle gate entry. Assign technicians, capture customer voice/complaints, and track live status.

Vehicle Inspection & Estimation

Standardized digital checklists with scratch marks, fuel gauge records, and initial estimates sent directly for customer WhatsApp/SMS approval.

Spare Parts Issue & Consumption

Link parts requisition directly to job cards. Deduct inventory automatically upon technician issue to prevent shrinkage.

GST-Ready Invoicing & Billing

Split billing into labor charges and spare parts with applicable HSN/SAC codes, GST breakdowns, discounts, and payment records.

Automated Service & PUC Reminders

Scheduled automated reminders based on elapsed days or predicted mileage for scheduled maintenance, oil changes, and insurance renewals.

End-to-End Workflow

How Information Flows From Arrival to Handover

Eliminate manual bottlenecks with an automated 5-step operational pipeline.

01

Vehicle Gate Entry

Capture vehicle number, mileage, initial inspection notes, and fuel level.

02

Job Card & Estimate

Create itemized estimate of spares and labor; get customer sign-off.

03

Technician Assignment

Assign mechanic bay; issue parts from stockroom with automatic deduction.

04

Quality Check & Billing

Perform final inspection checklist and generate GST invoice.

05

Follow-up & Retention

Automated service feedback and preventive maintenance reminder schedule.

Stakeholder Value

Tailored Value for Every Business Persona

Different team members interact with the software differently. Here is how each role benefits.

Workshop Owner

Complete bird-eye visibility on daily revenue, mechanic productivity, and spare parts gross margins.

Service Advisor

Quick job card creation, error-free customer approvals, and clear repair progress tracking.

Lead Mechanic

Clear task instructions, seamless parts requisition, and reduced paperwork.

Accountant

Automatic GST reports, vendor purchase bills reconciliation, and cash/UPI collection ledgers.

Security & Role-Based Governance

Access policies can be scoped by role and workflow. The permissions needed for your team should be confirmed during product evaluation and setup.

  • Hosting and encryption controls confirmed per deployment
  • Backup and recovery arrangements defined for the selected service
  • Audit history can be scoped to relevant workflows

3 to 10-Day Implementation & Staff Onboarding

We know your business cannot stop for software upgrades. Our onboarding team provides turnkey data migration from your existing spreadsheets, hardware integration (barcode guns/printers), and live staff training.

  • Automated CSV/Excel import templates for SKU catalogs & customer databases
  • Personalized screen share training for advisors, cashiers & managers
  • Dedicated deployment manager during your first two weeks of go-live
